notes: ConversationUnfollowed now durably attributes each new cleanup cutoff to removed_group_id, while follow_retained is true only for a follow that exists in ConversationFollowers; an initially unfollowed shared member therefore gets one idempotent cutoff fact, remains absent from aggregate/projected effective followers, and receives no reply delivery. FollowConversation/ConversationFollowed carry canonical authorizing_group_ids, and MessageSent carries sender_follow_group_ids captured from the root audience or the authoritative writable groups used for a reply; current-member manual follows capture authoritative readable groups. ConversationFollowers allows generation G when any captured source group is uncut at G, rejects work sourced only from the removed group, and treats historic absent source/group fields as conservative conversation-wide ordering. Ordinary unfollow preserves cutoffs and completed cleanup IDs. Existing policy tests retain the durable MemberFollowCleanupRecorded checkpoint barrier, unrelated-follow preservation, newer post-re-add safety, system-group no-ops, and accepted task-001 GroupMemberRemoved-only/idempotent role-preserving behavior. Superseded TDD runs first failed on missing struct fields and later exposed an incorrect EmailDeliveryCreated field name plus an empty-recipient fixture; those diagnostics were corrected before the successful final runs.
